turns_text: [SEG0001] person_1 (NURSE): Morning. Before the doctor calls you in, the BP is one thirty-eight over eighty-six, and the file shows amlodipine five milligrams.
[SEG0002] person_2 (FAMILY_MEMBER): Five milligrams? No, sister, at home the strip is ten milligrams. He takes one tablet every morning.
[SEG0003] person_3 (PATIENT): I don't look at the number, na, I swallow whatever is in the steel box. This cough is the real headache, it is there since so many weeks.
[SEG0004] person_4 (DOCTOR): Sorry, one minute, the screen has frozen again. Yes, cough. Since when exactly?
[SEG0005] person_3 (PATIENT): Since the flu only. Six weeks now. First the fever came, body was paining, then the fever—
[SEG0006] person_2 (FAMILY_MEMBER): The fever settled in four days.
[SEG0007] person_3 (PATIENT): Yes, fever is gone, but the cough stayed. At night it gets worse, my sleep is spoilt, and I cannot lie flat.
[SEG0008] person_4 (DOCTOR): The page just jumped. Kindly say again, the cough is from when?
[SEG0009] person_3 (PATIENT): Six weeks. After that flu. Nights are the worst.
[SEG0010] person_4 (DOCTOR): Any phlegm, what colour, any blood?
[SEG0011] person_3 (PATIENT): Phlegm, hmm, my neighbour Sharma also started a cough after fitting a new Voltas AC, very noisy, and his wife was telling—
[SEG0012] person_2 (FAMILY_MEMBER): Suresh, leave Sharma. Answer the doctor.
[SEG0013] person_3 (PATIENT): Sorry. A little white phlegm only, not yellow. No blood in it.
[SEG0014] person_4 (DOCTOR): Breathlessness when you walk?
[SEG0015] person_2 (FAMILY_MEMBER): He will now give you the temple story, just see.
[SEG0016] person_3 (PATIENT): Temple and back I am fine, no breathing trouble. No fever these days either, that finished with the flu.
[SEG0017] person_4 (DOCTOR): Any loss of weight?
[SEG0018] person_3 (PATIENT): No weight loss. I am eating two rotis, dal, and Sunday fish, proper food only.
[SEG0019] person_4 (DOCTOR): Any recent travel? Anyone around you with TB?
[SEG0020] person_3 (PATIENT): Travel, no. My sister's place is in the same city, not outstation. And TB, nobody, I am sure.
[SEG0021] person_4 (DOCTOR): Cursor is stuck. You said no one with TB?
[SEG0022] person_3 (PATIENT): No TB. Nobody in the house.
[SEG0023] person_2 (FAMILY_MEMBER): What about cousin Raju? He stayed with us one week in March, coughing the whole time, and they were saying it might be TB.
[SEG0024] person_3 (PATIENT): That was a cold only, not TB. He is in Kochi and perfectly fine, why you are bringing Raju now.
[SEG0025] person_4 (DOCTOR): I am not going to put a name on this today. The cough is worse at which time? I half heard it.
[SEG0026] person_3 (PATIENT): At night. Morning there is a little also, but night is the main problem.
[SEG0027] person_4 (DOCTOR): Any chest pain along with the cough?
[SEG0028] person_3 (PATIENT): No chest pain. Oh, actually, my trousers have become loose. I shifted the belt by two holes, so maybe the weight did come down. The scale battery died and—
[SEG0029] person_2 (FAMILY_MEMBER): The scale is dead since Diwali. He is not making it up.
[SEG0030] person_4 (DOCTOR): Right. I want a chest X-ray. I will not say what this is until I have seen the film.
[SEG0031] person_3 (PATIENT): X-ray like the one for my knee? I slipped by the bathroom bucket, the floor was wet, and the technician was so tall he—
[SEG0032] person_4 (DOCTOR): This one is the chest, not the knee. Today if there is a slot, otherwise tomorrow morning.
[SEG0033] person_1 (NURSE): I can book the chest X-ray for tomorrow morning, eight thirty. The slot is open.
[SEG0034] person_4 (DOCTOR): Yes, book it. And come back to see me in two weeks with the report.
[SEG0035] person_3 (PATIENT): Two weeks is fine. I should continue the pressure tablet, no?
[SEG0036] person_4 (DOCTOR): Continue whatever you are already taking until we sort the strength. Bring the strip with you next time.
[SEG0037] person_2 (FAMILY_MEMBER): I will keep the strip in my handbag. It is ten milligrams, I saw it last night.
[SEG0038] person_1 (NURSE): The file still says five milligrams. I will note both figures for you, doctor.
[SEG0039] person_4 (DOCTOR): If you cough up blood, or you cannot get your breath, do not wait for those two weeks, come straight away.
[SEG0040] person_3 (PATIENT): Understood, doctor. Fish curry is allowed, no? My wife will ask the moment we reach home.
[SEG0041] person_4 (DOCTOR): Eat as you usually eat. Nothing to stop for this cough.
[SEG0042] person_3 (PATIENT): Very good, because Sunday fish is there since my father's time, he used to bring seer fish from the market near the—
[SEG0043] person_2 (FAMILY_MEMBER): Suresh, enough. Other patients are waiting.
[SEG0044] person_3 (PATIENT): Ok ok, I am stopping. Thank you, doctor. Sharma and the AC I will tell you next time, it is actually quite funny.
[SEG0045] person_4 (DOCTOR): Take care. Pick up the X-ray slip from the nurse outside.

features: disputed_numbers: the nurse reads a value and the patient or relative disagrees or remembers another (a dose, a weight, a BP). Keep both and record an uncertainty.
interruptions_trailing_off: people interrupt each other, trail off, or the answer comes two turns after the question.

Fever resolved after four days, but duration was stated by family member, not patient.

omissions.text: Amlodipine dose is discrepant and specifically stated as 10 mg by the family member, one tablet every morning; the recorded medication entry omits the dose.
The patient said he cannot lie flat because the cough gets worse at night.
The patient said the cough also occurs a little in the morning, with night being the main problem.
Body pain occurred with the initial flu illness before the cough persisted.

Loss of weight was initially denied, but later the patient reported possible weight loss: trousers became loose and belt moved by two holes; this creates a contradiction rather than a simple negative finding of no weight loss.
The doctor explicitly said he was not going to put a diagnosis on this today and would wait until seeing the chest X-ray film.
The chest X-ray was to be done today if there was a slot, otherwise tomorrow morning; only tomorrow morning scheduling was recorded.
